doc:
Two videos, one cartridge

Frames 0–599 are NASA SVS Artemis animation; frames 600–899 are real launch-camera footage. Start pauses/resumes, A resumes after seeking, L/R step one frame, and Left/Right seek one second or shuttle at 2×, 4×, then 8× when held. Browser keyboards and phone touch controllers use the matching on-screen SNES controls.

Sources: NASA SVS 14191 animation and NASA Artemis I press-site camera footage. No Duck and Cover footage or animated turtle sequence is present.
